Resolves #18659
Refs #17844

The Workstation topology bar's readout now hides through `hidden` instead of a `neo-hidden` class, so a readout with nothing to say leaves the bar's row instead of holding an invisible box in it. In the 800×600 headless window the #17844 census runs in, that box wrapped the bar onto a second row and took 40px from the dock, and five Workstation Neural Link arms went red on the loss.
- `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs`: the readout binds `hidden` to the same formatter as its text, and its class is static.
- The unit arm that walks the shipped, modified and undone states now also reads whether the readout holds a box in the row.

Evidence: L3 achieved — the affected Neural Link spec files run whole against the external Brain runtime, beside the unit and component tiers → L3 required for AC-3. Those NL specs run in no CI workflow. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

|---|---|
| AC-1 | `Workspace.mjs:476` binds `hidden` to `!Workspace.topologyStateText(...)`, and the component's default `hideMode: 'removeDom'` removes the DOM. The unit arm reads `vdom.removeDom` at all three states. |
| AC-2 | `Workspace.spec.mjs:3405–3418`: `inRow` is false at the shipped and undone states and true while the readout says "Modified from default". With the code change stashed, the file ran 1 failed / 76 passed, failing at the first expectation (`inRow` expected false, received true). With the change, 77 passed. |
| AC-3 | The three files ran whole at f9aa2b5cf7, whose app and spec files are the head's (the amend added only the size baseline row). HumanPopupOverlap `:650`/`:722` passed and both large-over-small arms skipped on stage width. PopOutSparklines `:68` passed. TearOutSourceContinuity `:1017`/`:1022` passed, and `:669` stayed red on its 1200px display requirement. A bar probe in the same window measured a 45px bar and a 326px dock host, with no readout among the bar's children. |
| AC-4 | #17844's current-state block attributes the five arms to #18659 (published 2026-09-13T11:57:39Z). |
